paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA sikha Mosi sih nung in Mosi nasempa Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah TOUPA'N
heading: Kanaan Gam La Ding In TOUPA'N Joshua Thu Apia

paite: "Ka sikha Mosi asita a; thou inla, nang leh hiai mipi tengteng in Jordan lui kan unla, Israel suante ka piak gam ah pai un.
Mosi kiang a ka gensa bang in na khepek ua na sikna peuhmah uh ka hon pe vek ding.
Gamdai a pan leh hiai Lebanon tang a pan lui lianpi Euphrates Luipi pha a, Hitte gam tengteng, nitumna lam a tuipi zatak pha in na gam uh ahi ding.
Na damsung teng kuamah himhim in hon nangzou kei ding. Mosi kiang a ka om bang in, nang kiang ah leng ka om ding hi. K'on zuausan kei dia, pai leng k'on paisan sam kei ding hi.
Hattak leh hangsantak in om in; asuante uh kichiam a piak ka na chiamsa gam, hiaite luahsak ding na hi ngal a.

Ka sikha Mosi in dan tengteng zui dia thu hon piak zui tinten ding in hattak leh hangsantak in om peuhmah phot in. Na paina teng a na lamzan zel theihna ding in na taklam ah hiam, na veilam ah hiam pialsan het ke'n.

Hiai Dan Bu in na kam pawtsan het kei hen. Hiai a thu kigelh tengteng na zuih tinten theihna ding in sun leh zan in na ngaihtuah zaw ding ahi. Huchi in na lampite na tuahphasak dia, na hong lamzang ding hi.
Thu ka hon pia hilou hiam? Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n, TOUPA na Pathian na paina teng ah na kiang a om ding ahi," achi hi.
Joshua in mipi heutute thu apia a,
heading: Joshua In Mipite Thu Apia

paite: "Giahphual va sik unla, mipite kiang ah, 'Nek ding sutuah dih ua, ni thum sung a TOUPA na Pathian un gam luah dia ahon piak luah ding a Jordan lui kan ding na hih ziak un,' " chi in thu ahon pia hi.
Reubente, Gadte leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang ah Joshua in,
"TOUPA na Pathian un khawlna ahon pia a, hiai hon pe ding chi a TOUPA sikha Mosi in thu hon piak theigige un.

Na zite uh, na taneu chikchikte leh na ganhonte uh zaw Jordan lui gal a Mosi in gam hon na piak ah a-om ding uh. Nou mihat leh hangsan teng kigalthuamsa in na pai masa ding ua, na unaute uh na panpih ding ua,

TOUPA'N na unaute uh noute bangmah a khawlna apiak a, TOUPA na Pathian un hon gam piak amaute'n leng aluah mateng uh. Huchi in TOUPA sikha Mosi in Jordan lui gal, nisuahna lam gam nou a tuam ding a hon na piakna lam ah na kik nawn ding ua, na luah ding uh," achi hi.
Amau, "Hih dia na hon thupiak tengteng ka hih ding uh, n'on sawlna teng ah leng ka pai ding uh.
Bang lam peuh a Mosi thu ka zuih bang un, nang thu leng ka zui ding uh. Mosi kiang a TOUPA na Pathian a-om bang in nang kiang ah leng om peuhmah phot hen.
Kuapeuh na thupiak kalh a, hel a, thu na piak peuhmah zui nuam lou zaw hihlup ding ahi. Hattak leh hangsantak in om peuhmah phot in," chi in Joshua adawng uhi.
